content.story: In the circus, the top acts don't compete with each other — they're all headliners. The Top Dog award works the same way. The top 25% of troops by aggregate score all earn the title. No first place. No second place. Just Top Dog. You either are, or you aren't.
content.objective: Awarded to all troops whose aggregate score places them in the top 25% of all competing troops. All qualifying troops receive the award equally — no ranking among them.
content.description:
After all troop challenge events are scored and finalized, the Camporee Director calculates aggregate scores for all troops. The top 25% of troops — rounded up — receive the Top Dog award. All Top Dog recipients are equal: there is no 1st-among-Top-Dogs. Troops on the bubble should be determined by the Director before announcements.

This award is entered manually by the admin after all scores are finalized.
rules: Eligibility is based on aggregate score across all Troop Challenge events
Top 25% of troops qualify — round up if the 25% threshold falls between whole numbers
All qualifying troops receive the award equally — no distinction of rank among Top Dog recipients
Director's determination of qualifying troops is final
content.timeAndScoring:
Determined by the Camporee Director after all Troop Challenge scores are finalized.

Qualification threshold = top 25% of all competing troops (round up).

Example: 12 troops competing → top 3 troops qualify (25% of 12 = 3).

This is an admin-entered award — not scored in real time.
content.setup: No field setup. Compute qualifying threshold after all events are scored. Enter qualifying troops in the system before the awards ceremony.
content.staffing: Camporee Director or designated scoring admin.

supplies.item: Top Dog award ribbons or patches
supplies.quantity: 1 per qualifying Scout in qualifying troops
